description: Source code implementing AES key wrapping and unwrapping functions, including RFC 3394 and RFC 5649 standards, with internal cryptographic operations and FIPS compliance indicators.

methods.name: AES_wrap_key
methods.description: Wraps a key using AES according to RFC 3394, with optional IV.

methods.name: aes_unwrap_key_inner
methods.description: Performs the core unwrapping steps from RFC 3394, used internally.

methods.name: AES_unwrap_key
methods.description: Unwraps a key using AES according to RFC 3394, verifying IV.

methods.name: AES_wrap_key_padded
methods.description: Wraps a key with padding according to RFC 5649, handling variable length input.

methods.name: AES_unwrap_key_padded
methods.description: Unwraps a padded key according to RFC 5649, verifying padding and length.
